blocking_defects.finding: The frozen protocol requires one shared document bootstrap/max band over programs and backgrounds, but the scorer performs no resampling and publishes no simultaneous band.

The post-outcome scorer averages six program/background cells before gates 1 and 2 and flattens 32 documents by 3 programs for gate 3; those exact reductions were not frozen and do not operationalize the registered document-cluster/max-band language uniquely.

The scorer source and score receipt entered the same post-outcome commit and the scorer was absent from the pre-outcome 46-file HELDOUT authority closure; it has no independent pre-outcome source audit or focused test.

The scorer has no authority artifact, stable input hash-before/load/hash-after equality, guarded receipt-last callback, semantic reload, directory fsync, or failure artifact, and its score receipt does not bind scorer-source bytes.

claim_boundary.permitted_claim: The saved point estimates strongly disfavor the current adjoint/Fisher metric, and the current post-hoc reducer reproduces exactly.
claim_boundary.prohibited_claim: The score receipt is the authoritative preregistered bootstrap/max-band ruling.
